name: Wasting Money
overview: Scripture warns against the folly of wasting money, highlighting that the wise store up valuable resources while the foolish squander them (Proverbs 21:20). The Bible also teaches that debt places one under the authority of the lender, illustrating the spiritual and practical dangers of financial mismanagement (Proverbs 22:7). Jesus emphasizes the importance of being rich toward God rather than merely accumulating earthly wealth (Luke 12:21), and He warns that divided loyalty between God and money is impossible (Luke 16:13). The parable of the steward who wasted his master's goods further underscores the consequences of irresponsible stewardship (Luke 16:1).
